entries.subject: DAMIT 1858: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-1858.txt. Model 1858, version 2017-09-21, pole (343°, -74°), period 12.31241 h match the retained metadata. The archive diameter field is 114 ±8 km; its applicability to our scale is a separate calibration decision. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: AKARI thermal diameter as an alternative scale
entries.finding: [AKARI AcuA](https://data.darts.isas.jaxa.jp/pub/akari/AKARI-IRC_Catalogue_AllSky_AcuA_1.0/) — retained for comparison; the selected archive model has a physical size calibration. Its fitted nonrotating-sphere diameter is 106.21 ± 1.88 km. Formal catalog error omits additional shape, spin and thermal-model effects; no total confidence interval is invented. The original catalogue row for asteroid 23 was retrieved again and matched field-for-field with the retained row, including diameter, reported error and detection count.
entries.revisitWhen: A source-specific comparison with the selected shape and physical calibration justifies changing the adopted scale.

entries.subject: Resolved-model publication supporting DAMIT 1858
entries.finding: The live DAMIT model-to-reference export binds selected model 1858 to Adaptive optics and lightcurve data of asteroids: twenty shape models and information content analysis (2017). That publication supports the selected reconstruction. The imported entry conflated three surveys; listing them together did not establish three usable models or a registered reflectance mosaic.

entries.subject: Shape and spin alternatives
entries.finding: Alternative archive solutions: model 122, pole ['159', '-45'], [Model 122](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/asteroid_models/view/122;) model 123, pole ['343', '-69'], [Model 123](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/asteroid_models/view/123;) model 1857, pole ['158', '-46'], [Model 1857](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/asteroid_models/view/1857) The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 122: pole (159°, -45°), 12.31241 h, version 2009-09-23, archive diameter 107 km; 123: pole (343°, -69°), 12.31241 h, version 2009-09-23, archive diameter 107 km; 1857: pole (158°, -46°), 12.31241 h, version 2017-09-21, archive diameter 115 km. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: A released numerical replacement or independent pole/size constraints that distinguish the recorded alternatives, followed by comparison against the currently selected model.

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: The display scale "57 km (size-calibrated model)" (damit-models) implies a diameter of 114 km, outside the added NEOWISE V2.0 neowise_mainbelt.csv record 139452 (Masiero et al. 2012) diameter 98.039 ± 3.958 km (NEOWISE, NEATM). Both are shown; the display scale is not changed.
entries.revisitWhen: A newer release of the named catalogue, or a review that replaces the shown value.
